```plato
    //==
    // # Compose and Multiply
    //
    // Same contract as transforms: Compose(first, second) applies first, then
    // second. Multiply on two deformations is that Compose (enables `*`).
    // Multiply by a Number scales strength: p.Lerp(d.Eval(p), t).

    // Planar composition: apply first, then second.
    Compose(first: IDeformation2D, second: IDeformation2D): MappingDeformation2D
        => MappingDeformation2D(p => second.Eval(first.Eval(p)));
```
